name: factory
description: A small, visual software factory: /factory <feature> runs a feature or bug through spec-writer, builder, four parallel reviewers (security, ux, ui, code) and an approver on its own branch, then opens a pull request, answers human and bot review comments on it, and tells you when it is ready for you to merge (or merges locally, or hands it to you). Repo-specific commands and conventions live in .factory/repo.md, written by /factory setup. Ships a live dashboard.
